ev.q: Semiannualized TPT initiation and completion rates were calculated among persons on ART in 36 PEPFAR-supported programs
No statistically significant differences existed in overall TPT initiation or completion rates between sex and age groups
The TPT initiation rate peaked in FY19 Q4 (11%)
TPT completion rates steadily increased from 56% in FY18 Q2 to 87% in FY23 Q2
reached an all-time high in FY21 Q4 (1,802,814)
TPT initiation rates among ART-naive clients rose through FY22 Q4, from 17% in FY18 Q4 to 59% in FY22 Q4
TPT completion rates were lower among ART-naive clients compared with ART-experienced clients (79% and 86%, respectively; p<0.01)
Among ART-naive clients, initiation rates were lower among those aged <15 years than among those aged ≥15 years (32% and 51%, respectively; p = 0.04)
These TPT completions meaningfully contributed to the 2018 UNHLM target for TPT among persons with HIV
In 2018, the U.S. President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR) program committed to offer one course of TPT to all eligible clients receiving ART.
This analysis describes trends in TPT initiation and completion among PEPFAR-supported programs

methods_quotes.q: Mann-Whitney-U tests (α = 0.05) were used to assess stratum-specific differences in TPT initiation and completion rates.
TPT initiation and completion rates were aggregated across all PEPFAR-supported programs.
Data were collected through PEPFAR monitoring, evaluation, and reporting indicators.
